text: Current inference routing: WilliamOS sends chat inference to a generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint at WILLIAMOS_AI_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1) with model WILLIAMOS_AI_MODEL (default llama3.2:3b), wired by createOpenAICompatible name 'williamos-inference'. There is no Vercel AI Gateway and no silent fallback (RULE-0005).

Superseded inference path: chat inference was served through the Vercel AI Gateway using model openai/gpt-5-mini with gateway=vercel-ai-gateway, consumed by lib/ai/runtime.ts. This path was removed by R1A.

Current database authority: WilliamOS state lives in a sovereign self-hosted williamos-postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16) bound to 127.0.0.1:15432 on ATLAS, isolated from TerraFusion tf-postgres on 5432. DATABASE_URL points at the lab instance.

Superseded database: WilliamOS DATABASE_URL was a separate cloud Neon Postgres (databaseAuthority NEON_SEPARATE) provisioned via the v0 Neon integration. It was never a deliberate choice, only v0/Vercel scaffolding.

Current Vercel state: Vercel is retired under WO-ARCH-VERCEL-RETIREMENT. R0 disconnected the GitHub integration, R1A moved inference off the gateway, R4 removed VERCEL_URL from auth. next.config uses output:'standalone'. The only remaining gateway string is embeddings, pending R1B.

Superseded Vercel state: every push auto-deployed to the Vercel project terragroq (main to production, PRs to preview) via the Vercel GitHub App, posting 'Vercel' and 'Vercel Preview Comments' status checks.

Current auth origin: resolveAuthBaseUrl returns BETTER_AUTH_URL as canonical, plus BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS and dev localhost defaults. VERCEL_URL, VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL and V0_RUNTIME_URL were removed in PR #688.
Superseded auth origin: resolveAuthBaseUrl fell back to VERCEL_URL, then VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL, then V0_RUNTIME_URL to determine the trusted origin base URL.

Current worker-kernel decision: WilliamOS adopts the Nous Hermes Agent as the governed worker kernel under CAPG plus SEA plus OS containment (WO-WILLIAMOS-HERMES-KERNEL-V1). A custom WilliamOS gateway is explicitly NOT built.

Superseded worker design: build a custom bespoke inference gateway and worker for WilliamOS, hosted by the nested local Codex runtime adapter (issues #357/#358). This runtime is terminal and disabled; do not reactivate it.

Current embedding status: the pgvector embedding dimension is NOT frozen. A bake-off (WO-WILLIAMOS-SOVEREIGN-EMBEDDING-V1) decides model and dimension before any vector-contract freeze. Mixed vector spaces are forbidden.
Superseded embedding config: embeddings used openai/text-embedding-3-small at 1536 dimensions via the Vercel gateway, with the schema frozen at vector(1536).

Current dev topology: heavy development runs OFF OMEN. AEGIS hosts the repo, worktrees, dependency installs, builds and tests; HERMES runs AI; ATLAS holds state. OMEN is the owner cockpit only (WILLIAMOS_REMOTE_DEV_OFFLOAD_V1).
Superseded dev topology: OMEN was the primary development machine hosting repositories, node_modules, Docker build caches, and running the heavy dev work directly.
Grant profile READONLY: may read decisions and evidence records; may NOT approve, may NOT merge, may NOT perform any write.
Grant profile APPROVER: may approve a pending decision; may NOT merge and may NOT perform production writes.
Grant profile OPERATOR: may approve and may merge; may NOT alter authority grants and may NOT perform production database writes.
CAPG DENY: destructive commands such as rm -rf, git push --force, or disk wipe are denied and the action fails closed.
CAPG ALLOW: read-only inspection commands such as ls, cat, and git status are allowed to proceed.
CAPG ASK: ambiguous or mutating commands require explicit owner confirmation before they may proceed.

WO-ARCH-VERCEL-RETIREMENT (issue #638): remove the Vercel AI Gateway and OpenAI defaults, drop VERCEL_URL from auth, disconnect the GitHub integration, classify Supabase. R1B embeddings is the explicit outstanding acceptance gate.

WO-WILLIAMOS-SOVEREIGN-EMBEDDING-V1: the sovereign embedding bake-off. It is the gate that must close before issue #638 can close. Phases: model discovery, hardware/quality bake-off, then vector-contract freeze.
WO-WILLIAMOS-HERMES-KERNEL-V1: adopt the Nous Hermes Agent as the governed worker kernel with a binding memory/retrieval gate — no canonical embedding-backed memory until the embedding WO closes.

WO #538 (CLOSED): established the authority-aware placement and bounded-dispatch substrate for remote development, and pointed to the practical goal WILLIAMOS_REMOTE_DEV_OFFLOAD_V1 (stop OMEN being the dev machine).
PR #675 (Vercel retirement ledger) was MERGED via squash commit 63b2787. It records R0-complete and the R1B outstanding gate.
PR #683 (R1A sovereign inference seam) was MERGED as commit 2929a69, build green. It replaced the Vercel AI Gateway path with the provider-agnostic WILLIAMOS_AI_BASE_URL seam.

PR #680 (Hermes Agent integration review) was MERGED as commit 5cb2dba. It concluded: adopt Hermes rather than build a custom gateway, with two seams (raw inference for RAG, governed agent for work).
PR #685 (T2 Hermes kernel scope) was MERGED as commit 8e728e8. Scoping only; standup, wiring and acceptance are separate gated steps.
PR #650 (sovereign schema bootstrap) is OPEN and awaiting owner review. It provisions 30 tables plus the pgvector extension and applies atomically to a fresh pgvector/pgvector:pg16 database.
GPU map: OMEN has an RTX 5060 with 8GB VRAM, HERMES has an RTX 3050 with 6GB VRAM, AEGIS has a Quadro K2200 with 4GB, ATLAS has a Quadro K2200 with 4GB.
AEGIS is a Dell T5810 dev worker: 28 cores, 15GB RAM, 1.8TB disk. It currently has NO NVIDIA driver and no container GPU runtime installed, so it runs embedding workloads on CPU only.
Node roles: OMEN is the owner cockpit, HERMES is the AI runtime, AEGIS is the dev worker, ATLAS is the state and database node. GitHub is the canonical code and evidence store.

NO_UNAUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_EGRESS: neither primary nor auxiliary providers may reach an external network without authority, data-class and receipts. This is the HYBRID_SOVEREIGN doctrine; local is mandatory but not exclusive.

Runtime ports: the sovereign williamos-postgres listens on 127.0.0.1:15432; TerraFusion tf-postgres is on 5432; the Hermes OpenAI-compatible gateway is on 127.0.0.1:8642; the local Ollama server is on 11434.

lib/ai/provider.ts exports williamosInference = createOpenAICompatible({ name: 'williamos-inference', baseURL: INFERENCE_BASE_URL, apiKey: ... }). This is the provider-agnostic inference seam; Ollama is a default, not hard-coded.

drizzle/0000_williamos_init.sql creates 30 tables from lib/db/schema.ts and begins with CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector so pgvector columns exist before use. scripts/db/apply-schema.mjs applies it atomically on one pooled client.

TerraFusion serves county property-assessment workflows. PACS and county data on the ATLAS tf-postgres instance are OFF-LIMITS to WilliamOS state; WilliamOS must never point its DATABASE_URL at tf-postgres.
Ad valorem property tax is assessed on market value each year. The annual levy equals the assessed value multiplied by the millage rate set by the taxing jurisdiction.
The IAAO coefficient of dispersion (COD) measures assessment uniformity across a stratum. For residential property a COD at or below 15 is generally considered acceptable.
TAV stands for Total Assessed Value: the aggregate taxable value of all property in a jurisdiction, used as the base for computing the tax levy.
Politica de egreso: ningun proveedor primario o auxiliar puede acceder a una red externa sin autoridad, clase de datos y recibos. Por defecto se niega la salida (NO_UNAUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_EGRESS).
Roles des noeuds: OMEN est le cockpit du proprietaire, HERMES est le runtime d'IA, AEGIS est le worker de developpement, et ATLAS est le noeud d'etat et de base de donnees.
El estado de WilliamOS reside en una base soberana williamos-postgres (pgvector) en 127.0.0.1:15432 en ATLAS, aislada de tf-postgres en 5432. Ya no se usa Neon.

RULE-0005 (no silent fallback): if the local inference model is unavailable, WilliamOS must fail loudly rather than quietly route to a cloud model. Automatic cloud fallback for resilience is forbidden.
SEA (Structured-Edit Adapter) applies bounded code edits deterministically with atomic rollback: an edit either applies and verifies or reverts cleanly, so a partial or failed edit never lands.
The Pilot 0 cage is a disposable, deny-egress container used to evaluate agent runtimes; it supports apply and revert and enforces network containment as the authoritative boundary.

Protective guard regexes in runtime-operator/policy.mjs and hermes-bridge/cli.mjs forbid mutating any Vercel setting. These guards mention Vercel but are safety rails, not an active deployment dependency.
A permissive resilience profile would allow automatic failover to a hosted cloud model whenever the local model is unavailable, keeping the service always-on. WilliamOS rejects this profile.

Operator runbook. Preflight verifies SSH aliases and container health. Preflight verifies tf-postgres, tf-redis and tf-mongo are running. Preflight enforces database isolation with Test-DatabaseIsolation, whose single rule is: do not point WilliamOS DATABASE_URL at the TerraFusion Postgres. The check exists precisely because WilliamOS state must remain sovereign. Later sections cover evidence archival, hash receipts, and rollback windows. Buried here: the sovereign williamos-postgres runs on port 15432, deliberately different from tf-postgres 5432, so a misconfiguration is obvious.

WO-ACADEMY-013 (WilliamOS glossary): a documentation lesson defining operator terms, the goal loop, work-order governance, and evidence/authority decisions for onboarding. It is teaching material, not a runtime decision.

HYBRID_SOVEREIGN provider doctrine: local execution is mandatory but not exclusive. Governed external providers (including Azure) are permitted when authority, data-class and receipts are satisfied. Classes: LOCALOPS, HYBRID_APPROVED, CLOUD_DEV.
